'''Paul “Wiz” Johnson''' is credited on 5 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s as the source of the card image.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Set 1]], [[Virtual Set 4]], [[Virtual Set 9]], [[Virtual Set 10]] and [[Virtual Set 13]], sets dated 2015–2020 on this wiki.

== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 5 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s name Paul “Wiz” Johnson (5 image credits).<ref name="labels" /> The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Paul “Wiz” Johnson|Card Credits]].
